correctness.rationale: Exponential-time Brownian displacement is exactly Laplace; geometric bilateral capture tails give E[K], E[K²]. Exponential renewal reward CLT with covariance E[TK]=m/r-dm/dr yields the exact rate. Explicit differentiation and \(0<(s\coth s)'<\tanh s\) establish strict monotonicity, with equality only at stated partitions. Weak/strong resetting limits follow from uniform Taylor series and positive exponential tail gaps. 246 reproducible numerical checks passed; none are substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: A natural experimentally tunable capture-basin bias at fixed regular site spacing and reset rate has an exact sharp dispersion range. It exposes the covariance term linking duration to transport, a strictly increasing dispersion cost for directed gates, extremizer rigidity, and a singular rapid-capture limit. This is not merely the known symmetric diffusion or the known drift; it identifies the full functional gate-order tradeoff with an analytic proof.
